purpose: Datacube audit/refactor receipt for rev0191: close same-realm overlapping raw-store quota preflight drift and keep package budgets under ratchet.
riskFixed: Concurrent raw OpfsAsyncBlockStore puts could independently pass the same StorageManager.estimate sample before either staged write became visible, over-admitting transient staged+final bytes inside one JS realm.
runtimeChanges: Added module-level per-provider/prefix write-budget reservation ledger scoped to the current JS realm.
Passing guarded puts reserve budgeted transient bytes after estimate/preflight and release them when the put settles.
Budget rejection detail now includes activeReservedBytesBefore; snapshots expose activeWriteBudgetReservedBytes and reservation high-water stats.
The write-budget proof holds one staged put open and proves a second put rejects before creating staged/final files.
auditRefactor: Strengthened the existing write-budget guard proof/contract audit and kept current raw composite AbortSignal audit green; restored compact type needles instead of widening budgets or adding a new registry slice.
nonClaims: No runtime promotion or semver change.
Same-realm reservation is in-process accounting, not a browser quota reservation.
No cross-tab/cross-worker guarantee without Web Locks or a persisted ledger.
No eviction survival, fsync, power-loss durability, or cross-browser guarantee.
